who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), executor of track 4b task B, int-1112
what: A stored borrow-check verdict was looked at only by the gate (`gate::stored_passed`), so every other asker of the `borrowck` query (the diagnostics, hir/diagnostics.rs) ran the check again on a body the daemon had served; and a pass with an `unused_mut` lint was offered as a verdict, whose bytes cannot hold the lint.
cost: every served body's borrow check ran again whenever diagnostics were asked; a served verdict would have dropped a lint
cause: the stored answer lived beside the query instead of being the query's own answer
class: a cached answer consulted at one caller instead of at the query every caller asks
prevention: the query is the one place that looks at its stored answer; an answer is kept only when it equals what the query returns from it
fix: `borrowck` answers from `lookup_passed` itself; `kept` keeps only a pass with nothing to say; `stored_passed` deleted. Test kept_tests::a_kept_verdict_stands_for_a_result_with_nothing_to_say, control the_oracle_catches_a_verdict_kept_with_a_lint (KEEP_LOUD).
